title: aspidium glabrum
intro: Aspidium glabrum, commonly known as the smooth fern, is a type of fern that belongs to the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Aspidium glabrum include its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce menstrual cramps, and alleviate respiratory issues such as coughs and colds. The bioactive constituents of Aspidium glabrum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
